name: Tumble
blurb: Active:  Vayne  dashes in the target direction. Her next  basic attack within a few seconds will deal bonus physical damage.

effects.description: Active: Vayne dashes a fixed distance in the target direction, though not through terrain, and empowers her next basic attack within 3 seconds to have an uncancellable windup and deal bonus physical damage.
Tumble resets Vayne's basic attack timer.

notes:
This ability always employs Quick cast.
The basic attack portion of Tumble's damage is tagged as  basic damage and  spell damage, while the bonus damage is tagged as  spell damage.
The bonus damage applies  life steal.
Although Tumble will reset the basic attack timer, Vayne cannot attack until the animation is complete.
Vayne can cast  Final Hour during Tumble. She does not become  invisible during the dash.
